## How it works

Connect once. Ask in plain English. We handle the rest.

### We index your codebase

Connect your GitHub org once. We map every repo — the libraries, versions, and dependencies each service relies on.

### You ask for a change

Describe it in plain English — "bump axios to 1.7 everywhere" or "add a CODEOWNERS file to every repo."

### We prepare the PRs

We find every affected repo, make the change, and open a pull request for each one — ready for your review.

### We verify the pipelines

We run each repo's CI, automatically fixing and retrying when a build fails, then show you a summary of where everything landed.
